Raksha Bandhan Celebrated Across India with Greetings and Local Events

Raksha Bandhan was observed across India, marked by greetings from Prime Minister Narendra Modi and various local events. In Varanasi, sisters tied rakhis on their soldier brothers. The festival also saw celebrations involving political leaders, with women leaders celebrating with CM Chandrababu Naidu and schoolgirls tying rakhis for PM Modi. In Bhubaneswar, the transport department felicitated law-abiding drivers. Separately, a report highlighted the plight of siblings in Nepal amidst a flood crisis, noting the difficulty in celebrating Raksha Bandhan.
